# Demo Playwright TypeScript for Google Maps

> A typed Playwright + TypeScript reference for Google Maps interaction
> patterns (page title, search box, zoom). Never executed against live
> google.com — see AGENTS.md.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Caution about Google's Terms of Service, and what this reference demonstrates.
- [Spec](spec/index.md): The exact three checks, selectors, and expected behavior, as the single source of truth.
- [Citation](CITATION.cff): Citation metadata for this software.

## Source

- [demo.ts](src/demo.ts): The typed Playwright reference code — never run against google.com.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): The non-negotiable policy against executing this code against live google.com.
- [testingexamples.github.io/examples/google-maps/](https://testingexamples.github.io/examples/google-maps/): The site-wide reference this repo mirrors.
